{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "UNKNOWN",
      "title": "Hardcoded database administrator password",
      "resource": "azurerm_mysql_server.changeme_simple_mysql_server",
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "explanation": "The MySQL administrator password is embedded directly in the Terraform source, exposing a privileged credential through source control and code review systems."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "UNKNOWN",
      "title": "MySQL server permits public network access",
      "resource": "azurerm_mysql_server.changeme_simple_mysql_server",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "The resource does not disable public network access, which defaults to enabled and unnecessarily exposes the server's network endpoint."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "variable "mysql_administrator_password" {
  description = "Administrator password for the MySQL server."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "azurerm_mysql_server" "changeme_simple_mysql_server" {
  name                = "changeme-simple-mysql-database-name"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mysql_server_resource_group.name
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mysql_server_resource_group.location
  storage_mb           = "5120"
  sku_name             = "B_Gen5_1"
  version              = "8.0"

  administrator_login          = "changemeadmin"
  administrator_login_password = var.mysql_administrator_password

  ssl_enforcement_enabled       = true
  public_network_access_enabled = false
}
",
  "fix_summary": "Replaced the hardcoded administrator password with a sensitive input variable and explicitly disabled public network access. Existing SSL enforcement remains enabled."
}
